name: cobra-viper
description: Use when a Go CLI is built, reviewed, or refactored with Cobra and Viper — "cobra", "viper", a subcommand, a persistent or local flag, flag parsing, a viper config file, environment or flag binding, or a test that executes a `cobra.Command`. Not for general Go package design (use go), shipping a CLI binary (use go-release), or pre-implementation spec review (use go-spec-reviewer).
